fusions.name: Limb Drop
fusions.desc: Drops you onto a target up to 7 tiles away with a weapon strike that deals 30 damage and is always a critical hit. The target is left [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Juggled Hatchets
fusions.desc: Tosses 3 hatchets out of a juggle at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave its target [Bleeding] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hand-Over-Hand Chops
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Lucky Break
fusions.desc: Each time you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
